title: System Design Foundations
blurb: Core requirements, the reliability/scalability/maintainability lens, latency versus throughput, percentiles, and availability targets.

title: Estimation & Capacity Planning
blurb: Back-of-the-envelope calculations, powers of two, canonical latency numbers, and sizing QPS, bandwidth, and storage.

title: Networking & API Design
blurb: The network stack (DNS, TCP, UDP, TLS 1.3), REST versus gRPC and GraphQL, pagination, and safe HTTP methods.

title: Scaling & Traffic Management
blurb: Horizontal scaling, stateless service tiers, L4 versus L7 load balancing, health checks, and reverse proxies.

title: Databases & Caching
blurb: Relational storage and ACID, NoSQL paradigms, caching strategies, eviction policies, and cache invalidation.

title: Replication & Partitioning
blurb: Single-leader, multi-leader, and leaderless replication, quorum math, range versus hash sharding, and consistent hashing.

title: Consistency Models & Trade-Offs
blurb: Linearizability, eventual and causal consistency, the true meaning of the CAP theorem, and PACELC trade-offs.

title: Messaging & Traffic Control
blurb: Message queues versus partitioned event logs, pub/sub, rate limiting algorithms (token bucket, sliding window), and API gateways.

title: Resilience & Reliable Communication
blurb: Exponential backoff with jitter, idempotency keys, circuit breakers, bulkheads, and load shedding.

title: Transactions & Consensus
blurb: Two-phase commit (2PC), saga pattern, transactional outbox, Raft leader election, and distributed coordination with etcd/ZooKeeper.

title: Observability, Resilience & Security
blurb: Metrics, distributed tracing, designing for failure, disaster recovery (RTO/RPO), authentication, and defense in depth.

title: Architecture & System Synthesis
blurb: Monoliths versus microservices, service boundaries, and the step-by-step framework for designing systems end-to-end.
